conditions.scope: One natural startup60s cleanup; periodic600s scheduling source-only.
conditions.readiness: Initialized, actual isCacheClean, rounded actualdisk stats, stable cache turns, committed readonly IDB transaction.done.
conditions.timer_observation: Readonly owned renderer watcher observes actual old hash removal; no cleanup method call or timer patch. CLI reads watcher status only.

limitations: Natural 60-second startup cleanup actually observed. Recurring 600-second timer uses the same source callback, but no actual ten-minute capture was performed.

Readonly watcher polls hash membership every250ms; last-present/first-absent bracket collection, not exact timer execution instant. Native elapsed times and performance clock are facts, not cross-runtime scheduling equality.
Hash membership comparisons are only declared raw-SHA256 roles. Full hash lists retain native startup-note data and are not a portable complete-cache claim.
Candidate replay should require spontaneous idle cleanup without CLI requests; native watcher only observed membership and did not call/patch cleanup or change the timer.
